newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev eases on longer value date.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev eases on longer value date.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev eased to 1,565-1,575 per dollar in thin interbank trade in the morning from Wednesday's close at 1,564-1,570, due to the longer value date of spot-deals, dealers said.
"The lev lost some five (levs) due to the longer value date. Light volumes change hands as market makers are cautiously testing lower trading levels for the lev," a bank dealer said.

The value date of today's spot deals falls on Monday and the downside potential for the lev is around eight per dollar daily under the current interest rate spread between dollar- and lev-denominated deposits and current trading levels.
The central bank's main interest rate is now set at 17.14 percent monthly or 205.68 percent annually. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
